experiment.memory: Append immutable source-issued observation records with attempt,event ID,world session/revision,cue,Action and actual observed success. No hidden World evaluator or unexecuted counterfactual.

experiment.no_retention: Try action0 first on EVERY encounter and action1 only on observed failure, never reuse learned mapping, matched separate offline World instance.
